scope: Additive TH18 regular Healer L1-L11 direct-parent healing baseline.
game_version: Goblins Farm reports client build 18.600.3 for the current parent table; the official TH18 note and corroborating community page do not publish a Healer-specific client build.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
sources.limitations: Confirms the TH18 release and that some troops received levels, but publishes no Healer-specific level, value, target, healing, range, timing or geometry contract.

sources.title: Healer — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports L1-L11 HP/heal rate, housing 14, flight, friendly ground-only healing, no damage, 0.7-second cadence and 4.5-tile range. It does not define healing target priority or lock, chain/splash geometry, launch/impact timing, movement value, collision, target loss, tie or fixed-tick ordering.

sources.title: Healer
sources.limitations: Corroborates L11 2,100 HP and 82 healing per second, housing 14, flight, friendly ground-only role, speed 16 and 0.7-second cadence, but gives a conflicting 5-tile range and has no build identifier. The build-pinned 4.5-tile value is used; unsupported targeting, area and timing claims are not materialized.

support.note: The L1-L11 flying friendly-ground parent and sourced air-target exclusion use the shared Core healing route; Headless, Viewer and RL consume that immutable GameData route.

range_tiles.note: The build-pinned current value supersedes the prior unversioned 5-tile catalogue value; the conflicting value remains recorded in this additive delta.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent with an unversioned 5-tile range and a generic Core healing route that could select wounded friendly air troops.
changed_values.replacement: The shared Core healing route is explicitly exercised at L11 with the build-pinned 4.5-tile range; its parent-specific friendly target filter excludes flying troops through focused Core, snapshot/replay and Headless CLI coverage.
changed_values.justification: The current build-pinned secondary source supplies the direct parent values and explicitly says Healers cannot heal air units. No selection priority, lock, chain/splash, launch/impact timing, path, collision or visual rule is added.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source defines Healer target selection priority, target lock/reacquisition, same-tick ordering, target ties, multi-Healer stacking, hero-specific modifiers or combined-house-space effects; heroes are out of scope and none is approximated.

No consulted source defines healing chain or splash geometry, projectile origin/speed, impact delay, attack wind-up, flight path, collision, hitbox, target loss or visual animation timing. Core's fixed-tick 0.7-second cadence and T+10 ms logical healing projectile remain simulator mechanics, not claims of client timing fidelity.

The current exact parent contract is secondary. The official TH18 release note is not Healer-specific, and the consulted unversioned community page conflicts on range (5 versus build-pinned 4.5 tiles).
conclusion: Healer L1-L11 is executable through shared Core, Headless, Viewer and RL as a flying friendly-ground direct parent with source-documented exclusion of air recipients. Targeting priority, chain geometry, timing, collision and visual fidelity remain partial.
